resources.string: This backup contains the accounts and transaction history stored in KharjYar's local financial database.
Restoring a backup replaces the financial data currently stored on this device.
Could not save the backup file.
This backup is invalid, damaged, or incompatible with this version of KharjYar.
Accounts and transactions currently stored on this device will be replaced by the selected backup. KharjYar will restart after a successful restore.
